title: 第15章 刻录第16章 第一桶金
slug: 开局战五渣我靠空间挂机修仙
content_zh:
秦怀安两人到达这座城池时已是傍晚时分。此城名为永安城，是启国永安府的府城。
两人走在永安城主干道上，城内颇为繁华，虽然已是傍晚，大街上叫卖声仍是不绝于耳。
“胖子，我们先找家客栈住下，荒郊野外住了那么久，好好休息一晚上。”
“嗯，再好好吃一顿，自从去采矿之后，就没好好吃过，都瘦了。”
秦怀安转头审视王宝乐圆乎乎的脸庞，你这也没见哪少肉啊。
“两位公子，进来坐坐~”
“奴家擅长歌舞，进来让奴家给公子唱一曲~”
这时几个穿着清凉的姑娘围了上来，莺声燕语的招呼着。
秦怀安抬头看了一下，一座颇为豪华的三层小楼，门口悬挂一块牌匾，上书怡红院三个大字。
秦怀安也是第一次见到颇具古风的青楼，忍不住往里面打量了几眼。里面纸醉金迷，热闹非凡。
王宝乐见到这个阵仗，不知怎么，突然想起《大晋风情录》，瞬间面红耳赤，“不用不用，我们就是路过。”
“这位公子，奴家看您面生的很，是第一次来吗？来，让奴家好好伺候您~”
“秦兄......”王宝乐面露尴尬的看向秦怀安。
比这些姑娘穿着更清凉的，秦怀安在前世见多了，面不改色的推开他们，带着小胖子穿过此处。秦怀安虽不是正人君子，但对这种地方也没什么兴趣。
再往前走了一段，他们看到了一个稍具规模的客栈，两人走进客栈，这时一个伙计迎了上来。
“两位客官打尖还是住店？”
“给我们准备两间上房，再备一桌你们的拿手好菜。”
“好嘞，您二位请坐，饭菜稍等就来。”伙计把他们引到一楼的餐桌前坐下，然后就向后厨跑去。
一会儿工夫，一桌丰盛的菜肴端了上来。虽和前世色香味俱全的大餐无法比拟，但对于流落荒野多天的他们来说，也是极为满足的。
两人风卷残云，很快就把一桌子饭菜吃的七七八八。

这时秦怀安突然想到一个问题，“胖子，你有世俗用的钱财吗？”
“没有，到修仙坊市后基本用不到世俗钱财，带着也不方便，所以现在就没有世俗的钱币了。”
“秦大哥，你也没有吗，要不我们给他灵石，一块灵石至少能换十两黄金，都够在这吃住上几年了。”
秦怀安叫来掌柜的，递给他一块下品灵石。
这掌柜南来北往的客人见得多了，也是识货的。见秦怀安递过来灵石，他急忙道：“这太贵重了，我们找不开啊。”
“不用找了，晚上别打扰我们休息就行。”
“是，是！公子您请上楼，我们现在就打烊。”掌柜欣喜道。
两人各自进入自己的房间。秦怀安盘坐在床榻上，思考起以后的修行路。
content_en:
It was already evening when Qin Huaian and the two arrived at the city. This city is called Yong'an City, which is the capital of Yong'an Prefecture of Qi State.
The two of them were walking on the main road of Yong'an City. The city was quite prosperous. Although it was already evening, the sound of hawking on the street was still endless.
"Fat man, let's find an inn to stay in first. After living in the wilderness for so long, let's have a good night's rest."
"Well, let's have a good meal again. I haven't had a good meal since I went to mine. I have lost weight."
Qin Huaian turned around and looked at Wang Baole's round face. You don't see much flesh here.
"You two gentlemen, come in and sit down~"
"The slave is good at singing and dancing. Come in and ask the slave to sing a song for the young master~"
At this time, several girls in cool clothes gathered around and greeted them in sweet voices.
Qin Huaian looked up and saw a rather luxurious three-story building. There was a plaque hanging at the door with the words Yihongyuan.
It was also the first time for Qin Huaian to see an ancient brothel, and he couldn't help but take a look inside. There was a lot of excitement and excitement inside.
When Wang Baole saw this formation, for some reason, he suddenly remembered "Da Jin Style Record" and instantly blushed, "No, no, we are just passing by."
"This young master, I think you are very cool. Is this your first time here? Come, let me take good care of you~"
"Brother Qin..." Wang Baole looked at Qin Huaian with an embarrassed expression.
Qin Huaian, who was wearing cooler clothes than these girls, had seen a lot in his previous life. He pushed them away without changing his expression and led the little fat man through here. Although Qin Huaian is not a gentleman, he has no interest in this kind of place.
After walking a little further, they saw a slightly larger inn. The two of them walked into the inn, when a waiter came to greet them.
"Two guests, do you prefer to stay in a hotel?"
"Prepare two upper rooms for us, and prepare a table of your specialty dishes."
"Okay, you two, please take a seat. The food will be here in a moment." The waiter led them to sit down at the dining table on the first floor, and then ran to the kitchen.
After a while, a table of sumptuous dishes was served. Although it was incomparable with the delicious and delicious feast in their previous life, it was still extremely satisfying for them who had been living in the wilderness for many days.
The two of them were in a whirlwind mood, and soon finished the entire table of food.
At this time, Qin Huaian suddenly thought of a question, "Fat man, do you have any worldly money?"
"No, after arriving in Xiuxianfang City, you will basically not need secular money, and it is inconvenient to carry it with you, so there are no secular coins now."
"Brother Qin, don't you have one either? How about we give him a spiritual stone? A spiritual stone can be exchanged for at least ten taels of gold, which is enough to live and eat here for several years."
Qin Huaian called the shopkeeper and handed him a low-grade spiritual stone.
The shopkeeper has seen many customers coming and going from north to south, and he also knows the goods. Seeing Qin Huaian hand over the spirit stone, he hurriedly said: "This is too valuable, we can't find it."
"No need to look for it, just don't disturb our rest at night."
"Yes, yes! Master, please go upstairs, we will close now." The shopkeeper said happily.
The two of them entered their own rooms. Qin Huaian sat cross-legged on the bed, thinking about his future path of cultivation.
